instruction: Star every email in the local Drafts folder

rules.sql: select sum(1) > 0 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 7);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding star to all emails in Drafts folder (folderID=7). The evaluator checks if attributeID=58 (star attribute) is set to value=1 for messages in Drafts. Verified from database: Drafts has 7 emails.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Incomplete verification - instruction requires starring 'every email' but SQL only checks if at least one email is starred (sum(1) > 0)
CRITICAL: Wrong comparison logic - metadata states Drafts has 7 emails, but evaluator only verifies that count > 0, not that all 7 emails are starred
The SQL query does not verify completeness of the task - it will pass even if only 1 out of 7 emails is starred
Correct logic should compare count of starred messages against total count of messages in Drafts folder
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change SQL to verify all emails are starred: 'SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messageAttributes WHERE attributeID = 58 AND value = 1 AND messageID IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE folderID = 7)) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE folderID = 7);'
Alternative: Use two separate queries to get counts and compare: starred_count == total_count in Drafts
The expected result should verify equality, not just > 0
